sources.title: Akbarnama
sources.author: Abu'l-Fazl ibn Mubarak
sources.excerpt: His Majesty's sole aim is to bring the world under universal peace.
sources.longExcerpt: His Majesty's sole aim is to bring the world under universal peace. This historical source from 1590 provides valuable insight into the asia region during the renaissance-early-modern period. It represents the voices, experiences, and perspectives of people who lived during this transformative time in human history. Such primary sources are essential for understanding not just the major events of history, but the daily lives, beliefs, and struggles of ordinary people across different cultures and time periods.

sources.title: The Baburnama
sources.author: Babur
sources.excerpt: In the month of Ramadan of the year 899 (1494) and in the twelfth year of my age, I became ruler in the country of Fergana. The province of Fergana is situated in the fifth climate and at the limit of settled habitation.
sources.longExcerpt: In the month of Ramadan of the year 899 (1494) and in the twelfth year of my age, I became ruler in the country of Fergana. The province of Fergana is situated in the fifth climate and at the limit of settled habitation. This remarkable autobiography from 1526 by the founder of the Mughal Empire combines military history with detailed observations of nature, poetry, and the customs of India.

sources.title: The Ain-i-Akbari
sources.author: Abu'l-Fazl ibn Mubarak
sources.excerpt: His Majesty maintains that it is a religious act to worship fire and light; surly, ignorant men consider it forgetfulness of God. But the deep-sighted know better.
sources.longExcerpt: His Majesty maintains that it is a religious act to worship fire and light; surly, ignorant men consider it forgetfulness of God. But the deep-sighted know better. This comprehensive administrative document from 1590 details every aspect of Akbar's empire, from revenue systems to court ceremonies, providing an unparalleled view of Mughal governance.
